{{Top|leg}}
The '''Allied Cabinet''' was the legislature of the various [[Allied Command]]s, mimicking the structure of the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Alliance Civil Government's]] [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|Alliance Cabinet]]. It was headed by the [[Chief Executive (Rebel Alliance)|Chief Executive]], chaired by the [[Secretary of the Allied Cabinet]], and staffed by the Secretaries of [[Secretary of Education|Education]], [[Secretary of Finance|Finance]], [[Secretary of Industry|Industry]], [[Secretary of State|State]], [[Secretary of Supply|Supply]], and [[Secretary of War|War]].
